messages:
alex: heads-up — deploybot scheduled an apply for tonight 23:00 UTC targeting tf-mod-networking and tf-mod-iam. change window: 23:00-00:30 UTC. Please ack if you need a hold.

maria: ack. what's the provider pin for this run? last time we had drift with the provider bump.

jordan: pinning to provider hash 4.29.0 (same as staging). plan shows only subnet, route table, and two service-account bindings. will run canary apply in prod-1 AZ first.

alex: canary plan: apply to prod-1 (az-a) with parallelism=2, wait 10m, then stagger to remaining AZs. If any iam role change diff touches cross-account assume roles we abort.

maria: sgtm. document the canary step in release notes and ops-runbook. link: https://internal.releases/redwood/2026-03-cutover (add a brief summary).

ops_lead: ops checklist — ensure KMS key rotation job is paused, deploybot will annotate the run with tag:release-cutover-2026-03. Also enable deploybot's soft-throttle at 70% CPU for the apply hosts.

jordan: terraform snippet i'll run for canary:
```bash
cd infra/networking
TF_VAR_region=us-west-2 terraform plan -target=module.subnets -out=canary.plan
terraform apply -parallelism=2 canary.plan
```

sre_oncall: rollback playbook if something breaks? quick steps please.

alex: rollback steps (short):
- set deploybot to hold: `/deploybot hold release-cutover-2026-03`
- revert commit in infra repo: `git revert <apply-commit>` and push to branch `ops/rollback-cutover`
- run terraform apply against revert plan with `-parallelism=1` and watch for IAM deny errors
- if network instabilities, detach new route by toggling temporary tag `redwood:cutover=disable` on new subnets (internal script: `scripts/toggle-cutover-tag --off`)

maria: add to that: if cross-account role is broken, re-issue short-lived creds via the emergency STS flow (ops docs `iam/emergency-sts.md`). we should also pre-create the revert plan now and attach to the ticket.

devops-bot: deploybot: scheduled apply queued at 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z for infra/networking on runner infra-apply-07. canary step enabled. tagging release-cutover-2026-03.

ops_lead: i've created the revert plan and attached to the release ticket. also enabled extra logging on the apply hosts for 60m post-apply.

jordan: FYI plan output includes this IAM change: `aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.foo -> will add sts:AssumeRole for arn:aws:iam::999999:role/partner-access` — double-checked partner team already signed off.

sre_oncall: i'll be on standby at 22:30 UTC. if anything goes sideways i will escalate to incident channel and trigger the deploybot hold.

alex: perfect. final: everyone please update the release notes bullet with the canary timeline and watch commands. ping here at 22:45 for final thumbs. :thumbsup:

maria: 22:45 ack. 

jordan: prep done, canary artifacts uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-deploys/2026-03-cutover/canary.plan

ops_lead: all set from ops side. :white_check_mark:
